panels.title: Sanctions seeds (indexer)
panels.description: OFAC + OpenSanctions + curated mixers, refreshed on the feed cadence.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS seeds FROM seed_labels
SELECT label, count(*) AS n FROM seed_labels GROUP BY label

panels.title: Worker denylist by source (live)
panels.description: What the worker screens against right now. Empty until the worker (pnpm start) is running.

panels.title: Feed entries
panels.description: Graph-derived watchlist entries currently served to the worker.

panels.title: Worker READY
panels.description: 1 = verifying. 0/no data = worker down or HALTED (fail-closed).

panels.title: Sanctions & mixer seed list
panels.description: The seed set the graph is grown from. The worker additionally holds these first-hand.

targets.rawSql: SELECT subject AS address, label, source FROM seed_labels ORDER BY label, subject

panels.title: Feed watchlist (labels served to the worker)
panels.description: Entries of the latest signed feed: addresses within 3 hops of a seed, plus unverified contracts.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e->>'address' AS address,
  array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT json_array_elements_text(e->'labels')), ', ') AS labels
FROM (SELECT json_array_elements((document::json)->'entries') AS e
        FROM feeds ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1) t
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Verdict log — action, score, decoded reasons
panels.description: Every on-chain RiskVerdict, with the reason bitmask decoded back to labels.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_timestamp(b.block_time) AS time, v.chain,
  CASE v.action WHEN 0 THEN 'allow' WHEN 1 THEN 'delay' WHEN 2 THEN 'manual-review' WHEN 3 THEN 'block' END AS action, v.score,
  NULLIF(concat_ws(', ',
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 1::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'sanctions' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 2::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'sanctioned_mixer' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 4::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'scam_token' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 8::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'operator_deny' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 16::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'sanctions_1hop' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 32::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'sanctions_1hop_inbound' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 64::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'mixer_exposure' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 128::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'fake_stablecoin_suspect' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 256::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'honeypot_suspect' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 512::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'contract_admin_risk' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 1024::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'unverified_contract' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 2048::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'upgradeable_proxy' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 4096::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'contract_check_unavailable' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 8192::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'token_check_unavailable' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 16384::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'owner_approved' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 32768::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'sanctions_2hop' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 65536::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'sanctions_3hop' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 131072::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'sanctions_2hop_inbound' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 262144::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'sanctions_3hop_inbound' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 524288::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'mixer_exposure_2hop' END,
    CASE WHEN mod(div(v.reason_mask, 1048576::numeric), 2) = 1 THEN 'mixer_exposure_3hop' END), '') AS reasons,
  v.payload_hash, v.tx_hash
FROM risk_verdicts v
JOIN blocks b ON b.chain = v.chain AND b.number = v.block_number
ORDER BY b.block_time DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT CASE action WHEN 0 THEN 'allow' WHEN 1 THEN 'delay' WHEN 2 THEN 'manual-review' WHEN 3 THEN 'block' END AS action, count(*) AS n FROM risk_verdicts GROUP BY action

panels.title: Blocked (veto)
panels.description: Packets refused outright. Withholding verification IS the enforcement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS blocked FROM risk_verdicts WHERE action = 3

panels.title: Awaiting owner approval
panels.description: manual-review verdicts with no PacketApproved yet. Release with: dvn-cli approve

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT v.payload_hash) AS awaiting FROM risk_verdicts v
WHERE v.action = 2 AND NOT EXISTS
  (SELECT 1 FROM packet_approvals a WHERE a.payload_hash = v.payload_hash)

panels.title: Owner approvals
panels.description: Human releases of held packets — the owner key, never the worker's.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_timestamp(b.block_time) AS time, a.chain, a.payload_hash, a.approver, a.tx_hash
FROM packet_approvals a JOIN blocks b ON b.chain = a.chain AND b.number = a.block_number
ORDER BY b.block_time DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Risk evidence observed (worker live)
panels.description: Which risk signals actually fired while screening packets.
